key_findings.title: Rainfall is not normal
key_findings.text: 65% of days are dry; wet-day amounts are best described by the Weibull distribution (lowest AIC).

key_findings.title: Rain has memory
key_findings.text: P(wet | wet yesterday) = 0.93 vs P(wet | dry yesterday) = 0.04; independence rejected (p < 0.001).

key_findings.title: Regression explains part of the variance
key_findings.text: Humidity alone: R² = 0.22. With 5 predictors the test RMSE is 11.6 mm vs 13.5 mm for climatology.

key_findings.title: Uncertainty is quantified
key_findings.text: Share of test days whose rainfall fell inside the nominal 95% prediction interval.

key_findings.title: Simulation reproduces the climate
key_findings.text: Monte Carlo mean annual total; observed mean 2103 mm. Simulated SD 223 mm vs observed 441 mm.
